textEvidence.text: Cyber Saurus is a Level 5 EARTH Machine non-Effect Fusion Monster with 1800 ATK and 1400 DEF. Its entire printed Fusion recipe is "Blast Juggler" + "Two-Headed King Rex". Polymerization requires exactly these named Fusion Materials in the hand or on the field, in any order. A valid Fusion Substitute may replace at most one specifically named material; every other material must be correct. The successful Fusion Monster enters from the Extra Deck, materials are sent to their physical owners' Graveyards, negated Polymerization does not consume materials, and legal space may be freed by using field materials. This card is explicitly NOT treated as a "Cyber" card regardless of its name. No other effect, activation cost, trigger, or restriction is printed.
